cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.

mechanism: A manages a worried wedding participant by offering form-filling help while requiring precise terms even for a hug.
confusable: Unlike simply refusing comfort, A is willing to supply it only after scope and duration are specified.
comparison: A hug request reclassified as reassurance differs from a rain-dependent umbrella loan.
seedUse: D190-a wedding guarantee and hug; S02-a takes documentation work and follows B change of requested support.
